name: Steamforge
description: Steamforge No. 9, the sealed pressure engine the Company sent north. Stores supplies, shelters the homeless and raises steam for workshops built against it or piped to it. Burns coal or firewood from its own stores.

name: Settler's Cottage
description: A snug rendered cottage for one family, with a copper rain butt. Burns firewood through the winter, unless a steam duct reaches it and its radiators take over.

name: Brick Rowhouse
description: Solid brick walls hold the heat: a large family burns far less firewood, and none at all with full steam on its radiators.

name: Stockyard
description: A fenced yard with a steam crane for logs, stone, ore and fuel.

name: Warehouse
description: A dry, rat-proof brick store with a loft hoist, for food and goods.

name: Forester's Lodge
description: Foresters fell mature trees for logs and replant saplings from their nursery so the woods never run out.

name: Woodcutter's Shed
description: A flywheel-driven splitter turns logs into firewood. Splits faster on a steam main.

name: Hunter's Lodge
description: Hunters bring in venison and leather, cured in the smokehouse. Yield depends on the forest around the lodge.

name: Fishing Dock
description: Must be built on a shore. A brass net-winch lets fishers haul in fish all year round.

name: Crop Field
description: Drag to size. Farmers plant in spring and must bring the harvest in before the first frost.

name: Quarry
description: Must be dug into exposed granite. A steam derrick lifts out an endless supply of stone, faster on a steam main.

name: Iron Mine
description: Must be sunk into an ironstone seam. A winding engine hauls up iron ore; faster on a steam main.

name: Coal Pit
description: Must be dug into a coal seam. Coal feeds smelters, boilers and the Steamforge.

name: Copper Mine
description: Must be sunk into a green copper seam. Stamps crush the ore as it comes up; faster on a steam main.

name: Smelter
description: A coal-fired blast furnace that reduces ore to metal. A steam blower on the main makes it work faster.

name: Toolworks
description: Smiths forge iron and timber into tools under a steam hammer. Workers without tools toil at half pace.

name: Tailor's Shop
description: A treadle sewing machine stitches leather into warm greatcoats. Coated citizens lose heat far more slowly outdoors.

name: Machine Works
description: Steam-driven lathes turn iron into precision cogs, needed for every engine. Runs only on steam.

name: Boiler House
description: A riveted coal boiler that raises steam in quantity for every building on its pipes. Needs a stoker and coal.

name: Steam Sawmill
description: A steam engine drives a great circular saw that makes far more firewood per log. Runs only on steam.

name: Pump Well
description: A brass hand pump under a copper canopy. Fires within reach are put out quickly; fires out of reach of a well burn unchecked.

name: Drafting Office
description: Engineers at drafting tables work through the Company's patterns, earning research points. Galvanic lamps let them work faster.

name: Steam Glasshouse
description: A glass hall warmed by steam pipes grows hothouse tomatoes all year round, even in the depths of winter. Runs only on steam.

name: Steam Tenement
description: A three-storey brick tenement for a large family, with cast-iron radiators on the steam main. Needs no firewood while steam flows.

name: Steam Fire Station
description: A steam pump engine reaches fires far beyond any well and puts them out in seconds. Works only on steam.

name: Galvanic Dynamo
description: Turns steam into galvanic power for the copper conduits. Feeds on a strong steam main and needs a galvanist.

name: Arc Furnace
description: A galvanic arc melts ore without coal and yields twice the metal. Runs only on galvanic power.

name: Analytical Engine
description: Columns of brass gears calculate day and night, pouring research points into the colony's projects. Runs only on galvanic power.

name: Gas Lamp
description: A cast-iron gas lamp. Homes within its glow are happier, and workplaces and building sites in its light keep working through the night.

name: Apothecary
description: A chemist's shop with a copper still on the roof. The apothecary brews glasshouse herbs into lung tonic, and homes within reach that are supplied with it suffer far less from the smoke.

name: Galvanic Precipitator
description: A riveted tower of charged copper grids. While it has power it pulls the soot out of the air within 12 tiles.

name: Galvanic Arc Lamp
description: A tall iron mast carrying two carbon-arc globes. Floods a wide district with hard white light so its workshops and building sites work through the night. Needs galvanic power.

name: Clock Tower
description: A steam-wound clock tower with four brass faces. The whole neighbourhood takes heart from its chimes. Needs steam.

name: Pump House
description: A coal-fired beam engine on the shore that lifts river water into the mains. Boilers make steam from the feedwater it sends them.

name: Windpump Well
description: A bored well under a lattice windpump. It needs no fuel and no keeper, and can stand anywhere, but it lifts only a trickle of feedwater.

name: Booster Pump
description: A steam-driven pump set into a main. Wherever pressure reaches it, it drives the steam onward at full head, so long runs of pipe can reach the far side of town.

name: Steam Trawler Dock
description: A jetty for a coal-fired trawler that drags its nets far out across the water. It lands three times the catch of a fishing dock, while it has steam.

name: Bakehouse
description: A brick bakery with a coal oven. Bakers turn barley into bread, which keeps far longer than grain in a pantry. A steam blower on a main bakes faster.

name: Steam Cannery
description: Steam retorts seal fish, game and vegetables into iron tins that never spoil. Tinned food is the best thing to have in the stores at the end of a long winter, and the Company pays well for it.

name: Steam Tractor Shed
description: A shed of traction engines that drag ploughs and reapers across the fields. Fields within 12 tiles are planted and harvested much faster while the shed has steam.

name: Guild Hall
description: A pillared hall where one guild meets, keeps its banners and settles its grievances. Choose which guild it serves: that guild's standing is much higher while the hall stands, and when it strikes, its members gather here.

name: Telegraph Office
description: A brick office under a tall wire mast that keeps the colony in touch with the forges that still answer. They will ask for help, and pay for it. Open the Hollowmere chart to read their telegrams.

name: Airship Yard
description: A gantry and gasworks that fit out expedition airships. Send crews from here to the silent forges on the Hollowmere chart: they bring back salvage, survivors, the forges' papers, and sometimes plans and relics found nowhere else. Every voyage costs cogs, copper, envelope cloth and coal.

name: Safety Valve
description: A weighted brass valve on the steam main. Bleeds a little steam, but no overloaded boiler on its grid will ever burst.

name: Airship Mast
description: A lattice mooring mast for the Company's airships. Laborers carry export goods here for credit, and every few months an airship moors with your import orders. The winches need steam.

name: Steam Tram Depot
description: Keeps the steam trams running. While the depot has steam, citizens ride every tramway at three times walking pace.

name: Pneumatic Depot
description: A small store on the pneumatic post. Depots on the same steam grid share their goods by tube, so whatever reaches one can be collected at any. Needs steam.

name: Automaton Works
description: Engineers assemble clockwork automatons from cogs, copper and iron. Automatons work without food or warmth but must be wound with coal. Needs steam.
